history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of Booking Request Submit function.
features: The “View Request” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to view the booking request “Received” from the customers. By default, the agency user can only view the booking request details and cannot amend the information shown on the screen.
When the user clicks the “View Request” option, the system navigates to the next page, which shows the information of the selected DCSA request ID. The view screen has the following sections:
•	Basic Information
•	Sailing
•	Cargo & Containers
•	Parties & Addresses
•	Communication History

The “View Customer Request Data (Meta Query)” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to view the booking request details as originally submitted by the customer, taken from the Temp 3 (Intermediate) process.
The data is shown read-only, so the agency user can compare the original customer request with the data held in the eBK interface tables.
The “Edit Request” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to amend the booking request details. Amendments are allowed until the request is accepted by the respective agency.

When the user clicks the “Edit Request” option, the system opens another tab page with the selected booking request information. The agency user can amend the details and “Submit” the booking information.
Once a booking has been generated against the request, the agency user can no longer make any changes to the DCSA booking request.

The “Validate QC” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to run the 2nd level QC check, Global restrictions and General restrictions as a separate process, before the booking request is converted into an actual booking.
The 2nd level QC check validates the following items:
Basic Information
•	Load Port / Discharge Port (Conditional) – validated against Port Master.
•	Receipt Type / Delivery Type (Mandatory) – CY, D, F, L, CFS or T.
•	Door Pickup Address (Conditional) – required for a door move.
•	Pickup Date – must be earlier than the gate close date.
•	Payment Mode (Mandatory) – Prepaid / Collect.
•	Payment Location (Mandatory) – validated against Location Master. If it is blank, the system automatically uses the POR or POD, depending on the payment mode.
•	Allocation Voyage (Conditional) – validated against Voyage Master and cannot be blank.
•	Cargo Call Type (Conditional) – raise an error if no ‘CG’ call type is found for BT_FROM / BT_TO under BT_UNKNOWN_VOYAGE. This check does not apply to Feeder voyages.
Cargo
•	HS Code – must be a valid HS code from Commodity Master.
•	Commodity Group (Conditional) – mandatory for USA trade, i.e. when the original or final location country is US or CA.
•	Package Type – must be a valid package type from Package Type Master.
•	UN Number (Conditional) – IMDG cargo only; numeric, maximum 4 digits.
•	Class (Conditional) – IMDG cargo only; up to four characters (numeric, numeric with decimal, or alphanumeric with decimal).
•	Dangerous Contact Number – numeric; the special characters ( and + are allowed.
•	Reefer Ventilation (Conditional) – reefer cargo only; allowed values N, Q, H, T, F, E, C, X, Z.
•	Temperature Type (Conditional) – reefer cargo only; C or F.
Containers
•	Empty Pickup – must be a valid depot code from HQ depot master.
•	SOC Flag – Y / N.
•	Cargo Dimension (Conditional) – applicable only to OOG containers.
Parties
•	Shipper data is mandatory. If shipper data is missing, a QC error is raised.
•	Party Type (Mandatory), Party Name (Conditional), Party Country (Conditional) – validated against HQ country master.
•	Reference Qualifier – must be a valid reference qualifier.
The “Create Booking (Single/Batch)” option in DCSA Booking Activity is used when the auto booking generation registry (new config with values AUTO/MANUAL) is set to “MANUAL”.
If the registry is set to “AUTO”, a background job picks the respective agency record from the pool table and generates the actual booking once the QC process passes.

In the manual process, the agency user selects one or more DCSA booking requests listed on the screen. When the user clicks the “Create Booking” button, the selected booking requests are created as actual bookings in “Pre-Entered” status.
During conversion, the system runs the 2nd level QC check, including Global and General restrictions. The booking request is converted into an actual booking only if the QC check passes.
Preconditions
•	DCSA standard data must be mapped and inserted into the eBK interface tables.
•	First level and 2nd level QC must be validated.
•	Global & General Restrictions must be passed.
Postconditions
•	The actual booking is created in “Pre-Entered” status and is available in the AFSYS+ booking module and ILISCyber Agency Booking.
•	The DCSA request status is “Received [Not Confirmed]” and is sent back to the shipper by calling the required HQ ITCS procedures.
The “Edit Booking” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to amend the booking details. The option is enabled only after the request has been converted into an actual booking.

When the user clicks this option, the system navigates to ILISCyber Agency Booking and shows the selected booking details. The user can amend the booking details and carry out further booking-related processing.
The “Communication History” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to view the list of communications received against the DCSA booking request ID.
The information is taken from the DCSA DOC HEADER table (T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER).
The “Timeline” option in DCSA Booking Activity allows the agency user to view the list of actions the agency user has completed against a booking request.
The timeline details are maintained in the T_LT_DCSA_TIME_LINE table.

events.description: Opens the selected DCSA request in a new tab "<DCSA Request ID> (<Version>)" in view-only mode, showing Basic Information, Sailing, Containers & Cargo, Parties & Addresses, Communication History and Notes.
events.triggered_when: User selects a DCSA request in the DCSA Activity grid and clicks "View Request" in the ☰ menu.

events.description: Moves the page to the chosen section (Basic Information / Sailing / Containers & Cargo / Parties & Addresses / Communication History / Notes).
events.triggered_when: User clicks a section tab in the request tab.

events.event_type: Button Click (SH / CN / N1 / N2 / FW)
events.description: Shows the Shipper, Consignee, Notify 1, Notify 2 or Forwarder party details.
events.triggered_when: User clicks a party button in Parties & Addresses.

events.description: Show Details: shows the selected note's text in "Notes Detail – <Booking Number>", filtered by the "Last N Days" value.
events.triggered_when: User selects a note and clicks "Show Details".
User clicks the refresh icon on the right of the tab strip.

events.description: Closes the request tab and returns to DCSA Activity.
events.triggered_when: User clicks × on the request tab.
